ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels covering approximately 95% of the visible surface area, with localized high-intensity (white) pixels representing approximately 5% of the surface area in the form of punctate spots and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across the entire fluke surface; punctuated by a stochastic distribution of approximately 40-50 discrete circular white focal spots ranging from 2 to 10 pixels in diameter across both lobes; high-intensity clusters are concentrated on the far distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 32 degrees; depth extends approximately 15% into the total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with sharp, jagged serrations; peaks on the left lobe show an amplitude of 10-15 pixels; the right lobe exhibits higher frequency but lower amplitude serrations along the medial edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a linear diagonal sweep leading to a sharp, tapered distal tip; right lobe exhibits a more pronounced convex curve (broadening) before tapering to a rounded distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of circular white pixel clusters (scarring constellations) distributed across the mid-region of both lobes; several high-contrast white circles with dark centers are visible on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of faint, thin, light-gray unaligned linear disruptions (rake-like marks) visible in the lower-central region of the right lobe, crossing the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive calcified clusters (barnacles) localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, altering the natural geometric contour of the fluke tips; multiple circular white scars (likely former attachment sites) scattered across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant lobe asymmetry; the left lobe is notably more elongated and narrow towards the tip, while the right lobe is wider and more vertically oriented.
